tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// mdos chog nam mkha'i mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// ye shes mgon nyid srid du 'dre dang zhir// lha kun gzhir gyur rnam pa so so'i mdun// rgya che bla med mchod pa'i sprin chen po// kun 'bebs rnal 'byor mos pa nam mkha'i mdzod// des na kun rdzob lhur len 'drar snang yang*// don dam blo 'das nyams ler mi gtong bas// bden gnyis mnyam par khyer ba'i mdos chog mkhan// sngags pa'i rgyal por shes nas nga bstod do// de la/ mdos sgo dbye ba dang*/ rdzongs bstabs pa dang*/ mdos gzhug zor gyis bcad pa gsum/ dang po la/ rnal 'byor mdos bdag mdos kyi sgo 'byed pa gsum/ dang po ni/ he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis dregs pa zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ dregs pa'i mtshang tshig shes pa dang*/ lta ba'i gyabs dang ldan pa'o// gnyis pa la/ spyan drang mtshang 'dru byin brlab bya ba gsum/ dang po ni/ snyan gsan phab/ rnga rabs btang*/ de nas spyan drang ba ste/ hūm̐ 'jigs byed chen po he ru ka /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// thams cad gcig tu gdal ba yis// mchog tu bde ba'i thig le'i dngos// de la mchod bya mchod byed rdzas// spyan 'dren pa dang gshegs mkhan gyi// rnam par dbye ba cang ma mchis// 'on kyang de yi 'gag med rtsal// nam mkha' lta bu'i go 'byed pas// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar 'bum phrag /bdud bzhi'i dpung pa gzhom la bkod// de la bdag cag ma rig pas// bslad nas lha dang 'dre zhes phye// de bas gnyis snang can du thal// nyon mongs dug gis kun bslang nas// nag po'i sdig pa'i las la zhugs// rnam smin nad dang gnod pas mnar// de la phan phyir gsol btab kyis// chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la// sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul gyis// mi zad 'jig rten khams bkang nas// bu yi gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang*// 'dod pa'i don kun sgrub tu gsol/ hūm̐ sngon tshe rgya mtsho bsrub pa las// nyi ma'i spun 'khrungs chos sgra sgrog

/de nas cog rgan nyer ba dang*// bya nga se mo srid pa'i bu// che ba nam mkha' skad po che// tshangs pa lha yi rnga ru bzung*// chung ba rgya mtsho'i gting du bying*// klu dbang rnams kyi rol mor gyur// bar pa 'dzam gling mi la byung*// shing bsgrigs rtse ra'i pags pas g.yogs// li bying pho rdos brdungs pa las// gnam sa'i lha srin thams cad 'dus// 'di yis mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*// sde brgyad thams cad dam la 'du// dgra dang bgegs kyi klad pa 'gems// ma thogs dbyings nas 'bod pa'i brda// thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dam can rgya mtsho thams cad spyan drangs par bsams la/ hūm̐ 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyor mtshams nas// sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs gzugs// ye shes mgon po bya rog mtshan// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// rnam pa thar pa'i sgo gsum nas// e ka dza ṭī tsaṇ+ḍi ka /dud sol re ti mched bzhi rnams// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i thugs ka nas// hūm̐ mdzad nag po chen po ni// bka' sdod mang po'i 'khor bcas rnams// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bo nas// myur mdzad phyag drug mgon po ni// bka' mnyan bzhi dang bcas pa yang*// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// sing ga li dang ti se nas// zhal bzhi gnyan gyi mgon po ni// sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa yang*// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas// 'jigs byed las kyi mgon po ni// bya gdong gsum dang bcas pa yang*// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// stobs ldan gyad kyi yul khams nas// stag zhon sku yi mgon po ni// mon pa'i phyag brnyan bcas pa yang*// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas// srog bdag gsung mgon a gho ra// 'chol pa'i ging dang bcas pa yang*// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// rdo rje gdan gyi lho sgo nas// dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po ni// sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa yang*// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// mā la ya yi ri bo nas// legs ldan mgon po chen po ni// las byed 'bangs dang bcas pa yang*// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// ha ri ke la'i gnas mchog nas// 'phrin las mgon po gri gug ni// blon po 'bangs dang bcas pa yang*// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// gdong dmar bod kyi brag gdong nas// dpal gyi mgon po beng chen po// sras dang bka' 'khor bcas pa yang*// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// srin yul rnga yab gling chen nas// ma ning nag po chen po ni// srog bdud mon par bcas pa yang*// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// rgya nag ge'u te sha nas// 'jig rten mgon po trag shad ni// dad dpon sum cus bskor ba yang*// gsang ba

mdos la spyan 'dren no// mkha' 'gro drug dang sgo ma brgyad// ma hā kā li thams cad ni// sprul pa yang sprul bcas pa rnams// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// rdo rje'i pho nya drug cu bzhi// zhing skyong mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis// rang 'dra 'bum 'bum gyis bskor ba// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// srin yul rlung dmar 'tshub ma nas// za byed las kyi mgon po ni// ber nag lcam dral 'khor bcas kyang*// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// nai pā la yi zhing khams nas// lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po ni// tshe ring mched lnga'i lcam bcas pa// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// pad+ma dbang gi gnas mchog nas// rta nag dregs pa sde brgyad ni// rdo rje g.yu sgron yum ldan pa// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// so sa gling gi dur khrod nas// dur khrod bdag po yab yum ni// laṅka'i tshogs dang bcas pa yang*// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// 'dod gzugs lha yi rgyal khams nas// ma hā de wa yab yum 'khor// phyi yi lha srin sde brgyad bcas// gsang mdos la spyan 'dren no// tsa ri tra yi pho brang nas// bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum 'khor// las byed lha srin sde brgyad bcas// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// gshin rje'i rgyal khams chen po nas// las kyi gshin rje yab yum 'khor// sngags kyi lha srin sde brgyad bcas// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// ri rab chen po'i zom nang nas// gza' bdud chen po ming sring 'khor// myur mgyogs lha srin sde brgyad bcas// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// rgya mtsho brgyad kyi klong dkyil nas// nā ga rāk+ṣa yab yum 'khor// sbas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad bcas// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// mya ngan med pa'i sku mkhar nas// beng gdong lcam dral gnyis la 'khor// nang gi lha srin sde brgyad bcas// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// lcang lo can gyi khang bzang nas// gnod sbyin nag po ming sring 'khor// gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad bcas// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// chos 'khor chen po thams cad nas/

li byin pu tra bha dra sring*// rtag chags lha sri sde brgyad bcas// gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad nas// 'jig rten skyong ba bcu bzhi yang*// rang rigs sde dpung ci mchis pa/ gsang ba mdos la spyan 'dren no// gzhan yang ro langs 'bod skad can// nag stong sha za 'bum dang ni// khrag 'thung ma mo gnod sbyin tshogs// bos kyang mi khom mgron ma gtogs// thams cad mdos la spyan 'dren no// dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// bskul gyis tshur gshegs dam can rnams// dbyangs snyan rol mo'i sgra chen pos// bos so chos skyong snyan ma sra// gsung chen spos btang hasta yis// g.yabs so bstan srungs spyan ma rtul// sngar gyi dam bcas ngas sbran gyis// ci bsgo bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol// nam mkha' sa gzhi thams cad khyab pa mdun du byon par bsam la/ mtshang 'dru bya ba ni/ hūm̐ bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po// bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can// dam la gnas shing lha la 'phreng*// khyed rnams drag shul mi bzad pa// dpa' bo khrag 'thung he ru ka /dbang bskur rdo rje spyi bor bkod// dam tshig bdud rtsi ljags la bstim// chad rdo gnyan po thugs la bris// de phyir srung ma dam tshig can// khyed kyi thugs dam ngas bskang gis// nga yi 'phrin las khyed kyis mdzod// bsten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring*// rbad pa'i dus na mthu ma chung*// bcol ba'i don gyi las ma 'gyangs// jo bo bkur ro dbang ma che// mdza' bor byas so gzhung ma can// bran ltar bskul lo rgyu ma zhan// ma ltar bsten no ru ma nga*// sring ltar gshib bo khrel ma gtong*// do nub bdag gis nyes pa bshags// do nub khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*// do nub sngar gyi gtang rag gtong*// do nub phyi ma'i zhu ba gsol// btang snyoms khyad gsod ma mdzad cig /snyom las le lor ma bzhag cig

/brtse dang gdung sems ma zhan cig /mtho snyeg gsar 'grogs ma mdzad cig /rdzun dang g.yo sgyu ma mdzad cig /dpal chen khrag 'thung spyan snga ru// khyed kyis khas blangs 'di min nam// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ngo zhes// dkon mchog dbu 'phangs bstod do zhes// bdud dang dgra bgegs 'dul lo zhes// rnal 'byor ci dgos bsgrub bo zhes// dam bcas ma g.yel las 'di mdzod// gal te chad las g.yos pa na// dam tshig gnyan po'i chad pas mnar// bka' yi dmod pas bsdigs par 'gyur// de bas dam las ma 'da' zhig/ byin rlabs ni/ rang nyid ston pa/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar/ oṃswa bhā wa bishud+dhāḥ sarba dharmaḥswabhā wa bishud+dho3haṃ/ mdos rdzas shin tu dag par bsams pa chos nyid rnam dag gi ting nge 'dzin no// rin 'byung du bsgom/ sngar lag sor rtse sprad/ tshigs zur bcag pas sgrom bu lta bu/ na mas+sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i longs spyod mi zad pa 'byung ba nam mkha'i mdzod du bsam pa de'i ting nge 'dzin no// snang mtha' bsgom/ thal mo phyir dgyed mthe bong bsnol/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ nam mkha' mdzod de las so so'i thugs bzhed ji lta ba mod la dbang po lnga'i bdud rtsi/ dug lnga'i gsos su gyur pa ci yang 'byung bar bsam pa bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi ting nge 'dzin no// mdos kyi sgo dbye ba la bskos bstab pa/ mdos sna glud kyis drangs te bsngo ba/ yas chang ting nge 'dzin dang smreng gis 'thud pa gsum gyi dang po/ phyag rdor du bsgom/ lag g.yas rdo rje khu tshur byas pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng*/ na mas+sarba ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ mgron rnams rang rang gi mdun du mchod rdzas ci 'dod pa thams cad bdar bar bsam pa rgyal chen shugs ldan 'od kyi ting nge 'dzin no// mi 'khrugs pa bsgom/

g.yas rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bstan/ g.yon mchod sbyin gyi snod 'gegs pa'i tshul/ oṃ dz+nyā na a ba lo ki te/ na mas+sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa ra smi sam+bha ba sa ma ya/ mahā ma ṇi/ du ru du ru/ hṛ da ya ni dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ bdag gi lus zhing rdul gyi grangs su song bas yar mchod 'os/ mar snying rje'i mgron thams cad la pham rgyal med pa blo kha rdzogs pa phul bar bsam pa ye shes skar mda'i ting nge 'dzin no// rnam par snang mdzad bsgom/ thal mo khong stong sor mo nang du bsnol/ na mas+sa man+ta bhud+dhā nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañtsa dza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ phyag rgya phyogs bcur khyer/ mgron thams cad kyis bdag gi stong grogs ci dgos pa byed par bsam pa dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin no// ting 'dzin phyag rgya kun bdun bdun bya/ mdos sna glud gyis drangs te bsngo ba la/ rten du bsngo ba/ mchod rdzas su bsngo ba/ glud rdzas su bsngo tshul gsum/ dang po rten du bsngo ni/ hūm̐ bskang ngo skal pas thugs dam bskang*// 'jigs byed thod pa'i 'phreng ba can// mahā kā la yab yum dang*// nag po lcam dral ma lus dang*// zhing skyong mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro'i tshogs// snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs thams cad// rnal 'byor bdag la dgongs su gsol// byung ba rim brtsegs gling bzhi'i dbus// ri rab chen po'i rtse mo yi// sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba na// kun tu bzang po'i rgyan bkod pa'i// gzhal med khang bzang yid 'ong dang*// gdug pa srin po'i grong lta bu// drag po'i pho brang nyams zhud pa// gzhan yang ci dgyes bla rdor ni// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pas// chos skyong pho brang nyid du bzhes// zhes pas spyan drangs pa thams cad de la zhugs par bsam/ gnyis pa mchod rdzas su 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ gzhan yang mchod par 'bul ba ni// gnyis skyes rnams kyi rig byed bzhin// so so'i thugs kyi rjes 'gro ba'i// sku gsung thugs ka dag byed rdzing*// spyan ras khyab 'jug btsa' ba la// me tog kun gyi dpal mo'i 'dzum// ge sar zur mig g.yo ba nas// rdul sar 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur spro// shangs kyi dbang po brgya byin mdun// yongs 'du'i dri bzang nyid du 'thul// gzi brjid lha chen lta stangs phyogs// bdud kun sreg pa'i me bor snang*// thugs ka'i tshangs pa bag 'bebs la// bsam gtan gaṅgā'i byug par chags// snyan gyi dpyid du rol mo'i sgra// glu dbyangs mchog dang sbyar bar 'gyur// glog ltar 'khyug pa'i ljags kyi rtse// kham zas bdud rtsi'i sprin phung chags// gzhan yang yid srub rtse dga'i rdzas// 'jig rten gsum gyi gzhon du ma// mdzes pa yid kyis bris 'dra rnams// snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i glu len cing*// yid kyi do ra de dang der// dri zhim gar stabs ci yang ni// dbang po kun la bdud rtsi'i ro// reg pas gdung ba bskyed pa ster// chen po'i gtsug 'chang rin chen sde// yid 'ong rgyan gyi rigs kun dang*// dgra cha lag cha bzhon pa'i gter// gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong can// btsun mo bde sogs sar 'ongs bzhin// dmag dpon phas kyis rgol 'joms pa// 'dod skong nor bu bsam 'phel dang*/

glang chen thal kar mche drug can// sprin gyi shugs ldan rta mchog dang*// blon po phur bu'i shes pa can// nye ba'i rin chen thams cad dang*// bkra shis lha mo brgyad la sogs// srid zhi'i ngo mtshar ma lus pa// gsang ba chen po'i mdos kyi 'bul// 'di ni mchod rdzas thams cad pa// mi zad 'byung bas nam mkha'i mdzod// dgra mgo dbang po'i me tog ste// sha chen zhugs su zhen pa'i spos// tshil chen ro ras kyis spar dang*// snying khrag sha rus bza' bca' dang*// rkang gi rol mo dag tu'ang 'bul// bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba yi// dur khrod chen po'i klong dkyil nas// lha chen dpal 'bar mthu bo che// rdo rje srin po drag shul can// 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa'i shugs// 'jig rten gsum gyi dregs par lhung*// thams cad bka' nyan 'khor du 'dus// de phyir khrag 'thung rgyal por bsngags// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams thams cad// sku las mched pa'i me lces gang*// 'thor byed rlung gi 'tshub mas 'khol// 'ur 'ur chem chem sgra sgrog cing*// sa gzhi g.yo la ri rab ldeg /srid pa gsum po zil gyis gnon// khams gsum thams cad dbang du bsdus// phun tshogs thams cad rgyas byed pa'i// gzi brjid chen po'i byin dang ldan// lhag par stobs ldan bdud bzhi'i g.yul// rmeg med 'joms pa'i dpa' bo che// kun tu bdag gi 'dod pa'i don// ma lus sgrub par mdzad du gsol//

gsum pa glud bsngo ba sna 'dren dang bsngo ba dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzi byin yid ches skyed pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ gsung gi gzi byin sbar ba rol mo/ thugs spos sku mdangs mar me ste/ hūm̐ de ring gsang ba mdos rdzas kyi// yan lag 'bum ldan rol mo'i sgra// zab pa chos kyi dbyangs mtshungs pas// steng gi ye shes lha rnams mchod// che ba nam mkha'i 'brug lta bus// rig 'dzin srung ma'i thugs dam bskang*// snyan pa dri za'i pi wang 'dras// dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud// 'jebs pa phur bu'i tshig lta bus// lha 'dre mi gsum las la khol// hūm̐ spos kyi ma phyi dwangs dkar mtshe// pha ma spang ri nags ri ste// 'dus shing sring bu dri zhim spos// shangs tshim mdos kyi lam du 'bul// hūm̐ sku yi mar me snang ba'i dpyid// gsung gi mar me chags pa bral// thugs kyi mar me gdal ba'i dbyings// ye shes thig ler 'bar ba 'bul// yid ches bskyed pa la nas chang bshos rin po che'i mchod bzhi ste/ kyai bskal pa'i dang por ting 'dzin zas// bdud rtsi sa zhag rim pa'i mthar// dgung ma gnam gyi mthu phyung ste// dog mo sa yi rtsal sprugs pas// ma rmos 'bru 'khrungs le los nyams// zas kyi dbul 'phongs de nas byung*// mi ni thabs mkhas dpyid gsum btab// dbyar gsum skyes te ston gsum btsas// dgun gsum za ba'i 'bru mchog las// sna tshogs 'bru yi dpya 'bul lo// hūm̐ chu gter bsrubs 'thon lha mo chang*// myos byed rnam par brgyad du brdzus// 'thungs bas khong nas gzi byin skyed// lus sems bde zhing dran pa gsal// pho brgyud lha 'dre'i spyan lam na// chang las ngo che ci yang med// 'dzam gling mi yi skom mchog 'di// gser skyems g.yu skyems rngon chang 'bul/ hūm̐ dgra bo bsgral ba'i snying khrag dang*// mtshan ldan bu mo'i bha ga'i rdul// 'byung ba rtsi las rang byung rnams// mo brgyud dgyes pa'i rngan du 'bul// hūm̐

sha sna rus sna 'bru sna'i sde// khrag gis sbrus pa'i bshos bu ni// rtse mo gnam gyi dgung la reg /rmang ni dbang chen khyon du brdal// dkar dmar rgyan ldan bdud rtsi dngos// gnyis ka dgyes pa'i ched du 'bul// oṃ akā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+yā nut+pan+na twāta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ lan bdun gyis phul/ hūm̐ 'dod dgu'i snying po rin thang can// gser g.yu mu tig mu men shel// byi ru dung bse khrab byang sogs// dgyes pa'i nor snas mchod lags so// dngos la glud gtong ba dang*/ bskang ba dang*/ snang srid gsil bu'i gyer gsum las/ dang po ni/ gang slu rgyu de 'dra mor bsams pa'i glud/ ngar bya/ ngar lug ste/ kyai glud byung dang po gang nas byung*// glud byung lha yi yul du byung*// mtha' bral lha yi bu mo yis// rgya mtshor khrus byas klu yis bzung*// lha dmag drangs te bkug kyang shor// lus ngag yid gsum mthu ba'i glud// gdug pa klu yi bu la byin// lha yi bu mo grol zhing thar// de nas glud ni za hor byung*// rgyal po gra ba gzi bsnyung tshe// bram ze dge bas glud btang gsos// de nas rgya gar rgyal po ni// mdzes zin sku med rdo rje yis// bden pa'i smreng btang glud sbyin gdangs// de nas rgya nag yul khams su// rgyal po kṛ kri 'od bzang gis// bya ba log pa sna tshogs spyad// ltas ngan mtshan ma ci yang byung*// skyeg chen langs shing gdon chen g.yo// kong rtse 'phrul gyi rgyal po des// skor mgo sum brgya drug cu la// ngan pa lto dang glud kyis bcos// nyes pa ma lus bsal zhing bsgyur// de nas glud 'di bod yul byung*// btsan po khri song sde btsan gyis// dpal gyis bsam yas bzhengs pa'i dus// bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa gnod// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// so so'i mthun rdzas bzhed pa'i dkor// yas dang thags su sbyar zhing bshams// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// bden pa'i smreng gi bkrol te btang*// kun gyis srog phul bka' bsgo nyan// rgyal khams bde la chos khrims dar// de nas glud 'di de ring byung*// dregs pa pho mo'i mthun pa'i rdzas// mi nor phyugs dang khang pa'i glud// rang gi 'byor dang gzhan nas btsal// yid kyis sprul la sems kyis dmigs// tshul dang mthun pa'i cho 'brang bshad// gus shing dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bu lon lan chags 'dis khyer ro// kyai

ngar pha gnam la ya nga rtse// ngar ma sa la dog mo lcam// gnam sa gnyis las skyes pa'i bu// nam mkha' sems la zho sha'i snying*// dung gi rus la bse ye sha /mtshal gyi khrag la me yi drod// rlung gi dbugs la chu yi khams// zer spu'i skra la mu tig klad// 'gron bu'i so la le brgan lce// mo khab sna la lung thang mig /gro ga'i rna ba dbang po'i lag /yungs mo'i rkang la ngar gyi lus// bal tshon gos la dkor cha'i rgyan// 'ja' tshon sna lngar ya la la// khyu mchog 'gros su lam se lam// lha yi gsung snyan kyu ru ru// phung khams skye mched ye re re// bca' bca' de ni brdar ra ra// skyes pa dmag la chas pa 'dra// brgyan brgyan de ni spur ru ru// na chung bag mar chas pa 'dra// 'di 'dra'i glud phul lan chags skongs// gnod pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa sgyur// dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen rnams bzlog /tshe zad dus la bab na yang*// sngon gyi las kyi 'phro 'thud la// lo gsum bar du bshol thob la// tshe dbang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod// kyai ngar bya 'di yis pha smos na// 'dab chags gser gyi phye ma leb// ma ni rnga mo g.yu gshog rtsal// de gnyis srid pa'i dung g.yu gser// de 'dra'i sgo nga gsum brtol bas// sha gzan 'gum gzan 'dam gzan gsum// de las srid pa'i bya rigs gyes// kun kyang mdos kyis rdzas su bshams// kyai sngon tshe gnam lug ral pa can// mthing gi bal mo che 'khrigs pas// lu gu rigs brgyad 'jig rten 'phel// bzhed pa'i dkor du de yang bdar// bskang ba ni/ hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings nas khros pa'i gzugs// 'jig rten pa dang mthun zhugs nas// phan gnod las kyi kha bsgyur ba'i// za byed srin po chen po'i tshogs// rnal 'byor bdag la snyan gson cig /khyed ni chad pa'i yas 'gam can// khyed ni rgyal ba'i bka' sgrub ba// khyed ni bstan pa'i gnyer chen te// khyed ni dkon mchog rnam gsum 'bangs// de phyir bdag gi dgra lhar che// mgon skyabs dpung gnyen thams cad zhu// sgo gsum 'bad pa'i mchod pa 'bul// 'on kyang byis dang mi shes dang*// nyon mongs bag med dbang gis su// khyod kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan// 'phrin las myogs pa'i nyes pa ni// lus kyis bskyed pa'i rim ma gsal// ngag gi mtshang tshig zlos pa nyams// yid kyis ting 'dzin rgya mtsho yol// mchod bstod las kyi bcas kha chag

/chos min spyad pa ma lhogs pas// blangs pa'i bcas pa mang dang 'gal// mdor na ru drar skye ba'i las// ci bgyis gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshags// phyin chad bdag gis legs par sdom// khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// mthun rdzas bskal pa'i mdos chen phul// de yang snang srid kun gyi glud// rdzas sngags phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin gyis// nam mkha' stong pa'i rang bzhin la// rgya gram rlung gi 'khor lo chags// stong gsum gcig gi 'og gzhir brdal// de steng zlum po chu dang ni// gru bzhi gser gzhi gling bzhi'i khyon// de steng char gyi chu gter byung*// rlung gis bsrubs pas ri rab dang*// gser ri bdun dang rol mtsho bdun// gling dang rgya mtsho lcags rir chags// lhun po rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin// dngul dang bai ḍūr+ya dang ni// pad+ma rā ga gser dang phyed// chur nub steng du dpag tshad ni// brgyad khri 'phags pa'i phyed 'og ma// mnyam pa'i bang rim bzhi dang ldan// rtse mo lcog brgyad dbus na lha'i// grong khyer chen po blta na sdug /phyogs mtshams tshal bzhi yongs 'du dang*// chos bzang armo ni ga'i rdo// bar na yid 'ong sman gyi ljongs// dpag bsam shing gi nags tshal te// bang rim sde bzhi rtag myos dang*/ 'phreng thogs gzhong thogs chur nub seng*// lha min rnams kyi yul khams te// gling gnas gcig srin mi yi yul// rgya mtsho klu sogs dud 'gro'i gnas// 'di nas dpag tshad brgyad khri'i 'og /de nas lnga brgya 'das pa na// gshin rje rgyal khams dmyal ba 'og /steng gi gdugs ni go la ste// nyi zla gza' skar thams cad mtshon// tog gi skor 'og mtha' bral nas// gzugs khams 'og min dag gi bar// gzhal rnam skye mched mu bzhi ste// rang rang spyod pa'i 'byor pas brgyan// de 'dra'i 'jig rten khams chen po// dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams la// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi// nyams pa thams cad skongs gyur cig

/sdig sgrib thams cad dag gyur cig /lan chags thams cad khyer gyur cig /tshogs gnyis thams cad rdzogs gyur cig/ gsum pa snang srid gsil bu'i gyer la/ lus/ sems/ yul/ mkhar/ pho mo/ spyi gos rgyan/ sa/ zas/ skye gnas kyi glud/ dang po yungs kar/ bya spu/ bal tshon/ smyug ma/ rgyang bu ste/ kyai sngon tshe sku med rdo rje yis// rgya yi bkra shis khri sgo nas// yungs mo'i khung rnyed zhing pas spel// dpyid gsum 'dab mdzes dbyar gsum ring*// me tog ston gsum sgang bur smin// de 'dra'i 'bru mchog sa le sbram// bgegs rigs 'joms pa'i bkra shis rdzas// yon bdag lus kyi glud du 'bul// kyai srid pa'i bya rigs sna tshogs kyi// spu bzang yas kyi rgyan du bgyis// tshangs pa'i lha bya yid 'ong lus// snyan pa'i ngag ldan mkha' la 'gro// yon bdag lus kyi glud du 'bul// kyai rgyu ni lug shing srin las byung*// kha dog sna tshogs tshos kyis bsgyur// bkra shis smyug ma'i rtser 'char tshe// rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal sel// de phyir ye shes lnga'i bal tshon// yon bdag lus kyi glud du 'bul// kyai 'byung ba drod gsher srid pa'i bu// shun pa khong song byang chub sems// de phyir thags kyi gzhi mo ste// yon bdag lus kyi glud du 'bul// kyai rin chen smyug ma'i rtse logs la// tshangs pa bya yi spu bzang dang*// 'bru mchog yungs mo'i sgang bu dang*// mtshe ma than gyi mgal pa dang*// ye shes bal tshon sna lnga yis// rgyang bu dkris pa rim gsum pa// sku gsung thugs su byin rlabs pa// yon bdag lus kyi glud du 'bul// sems glud nam mkha' ste/ kyai nam mkha' dngos med kha dog lnga// 'byung ba lnga yi 'od las srid// ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rtags// sku bzhi 'phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs// sbubs kyi stong pa kun khyab mkha'// mthun pa rdzas kyis legs bsgrubs pa// sems nyid stong pa'i glud du 'bul// yul mkhar gyi glud shing bris te/

kyai shing la dpe dang lugs med kyang*// khams gsum srid pa shing gi dpe// srid pa spyi ris bris pa yid// ye gdal dgung sngon rgya re che// nyi zla zung cig 'od re gsal// mdzes pa'i gza' skar grangs re mang*// lho sprin smug po brjid re che// 'dab chags mkha' lding gdangs re snyan// ri shing khang bzang nyams re dga'// yang dag don rigs gang bzhed bris// srid pa'i dbang chen dkor du 'bul// yul mkhar glud ni 'di lags pas// yon bdag lan chags byang bar shog/ pho glud mda' dang pho gdong ste/ kyai smyug mda' 'khris gsum sbrul gyi rigs// rin chen nya mig phyag rgyas btab// sgro bzang bskyon nas mde'u bzang btsud// 'phangs na gza' rgod lam zhugs 'dra// yon bdag skyes pa'i glud du 'bul// pho shing stag par pha yi gdong*// yan lag bzhi dod nya mig can// za 'og gos kyis mdzes pa yang*// yon bdag skyes pa'i glud du 'bul// mo glud 'phang dang mo gdong ste/ kyai mo shing 'phang ma'i mo 'phang la// cha skor 'khor ba'i 'phang lo byas// bal tshon 'dab brgyan 'ja' tshon ris/ yon bdag bud med glud du 'bul// mo shing glang mar mo yi gdong*// yan lag bzhi dod nya mig can// za 'og gos kyis mdzes pa yang*// yon bdag bud med glud du 'bul// pho mo spyi mthun gyi glud bal ti shug ti ste/ kyai bal ti bkra shis shing gi tshogs// bza' shing rwa ba chen por chags// rin chen shug ti dpag bsam shing*// yongs 'du'i dbang por byin gyis brlabs// yon bdag pho mo'i glud du 'bul// dar zab pags pa gos glud de/ kyai lha yi dar zab pañtsa li// dpag bsam shing las gang 'dod 'byung*// mi la srin gyi kha chu las// rgya mo bzo sbyangs 'phrul las 'tho// mdangs mdzes 'ja' 'od 'khyil 'dra la// sna tshogs gzugs brnyan ri mor bkra// yon bdag gos kyi glud du 'bul// kyai pags bu drag por chas pa'i gos// glang chen mi dang stag gzig gi

/g.yang gzhi chen por bsngos pa 'di// yon bdag gos kyi glud du 'bul// btsag rams rtsi tshon rgyan gyi glud de/ kyai rgyu ni srid pa'i rdo las byung*// ming ni btsag dang rams zhes zer// kha dog dmar po yas kyi pha// kha dog sngon po yas kyi ma// yas kyis gzugs kyi kha dog bsgyur// cho che 'brang btsun btsag dang rams// snang srid lha 'dre'i spyan lam brgyan// yon bdag rgyan gyi glud 'bul// kham sa sa'i glud de/ kyai srid pa chags pa'i kham sa la// mi yi glud byas cho re che// mi yi rdzongs byas 'brang re btsun// kham sa glud du mi 'bul du// 'gro drug sems can sa la gnas// rin chen sna dgu sa las byung*// 'bru mchog sna tshogs sa las skyed// de ltar kham sa yon tan che// glud 'bul rdzongs 'debs bu lon 'jal// bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol// sgo nga zas dang skye gnas kyi glud de/ kyai dang por tshangs pa'i sgo nga byung*// 'jig rten de las byung zhes grangs// da lta gtsug phud can gyi sgong*// skye dang bdud rtsi'i gong bur bsams// yon bdag zas dang skye gnas glud// srid pa'i lha 'dre rnams la 'bul// gsum pa yas chad smreng gi 'thud pa ni gnyis te/ ting nge 'dzin dang smreng ngo*// dang po ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ sring mo bzhi bskul/ des ming po rgyal chen bzhi bskul/ de dag gis gnam sa rgya mtshor gnas pa'i srog chags longs spyod thams cad bsdus te/ mdos la bstim pas/ ci 'dod pa thams cad kyi phung po ri rab tsam du song bar bsam pa'o// smreng ni/ kyai khyung nag nyi ma'i 'od ldan pa// gzi mig rdo rje'i mchu sder rwa// spu gri ngar ma'i spu gshog can// gdug pa'i sa bdag khar bsrel dang*// bya nag srid gsum mthong ba'i mig /kang ka gnam lcags mchu ring dang*// bya glag sder mo'i mthu can dang*// 'ug pa gser gyi mig po che// srin bya zangs kyi sder can dang*// bye khra rtsal gyis snyems pa ste// sha gzan mchu gug dag gi rigs// gnam gyi gshan pa gtum dgu dang*// shang shang bya yi tshong dpon dang*// rma bya zlos gar mkhan po dang*// ka la piṅka glu dbyangs mkhan// bya nag mchu dmar mchu ser dang*// khyim bya gtsug phud can dag dang*// gong mo lha bya sreg pa 'dre// bya wang bon du rdzu ba sogs// 'gum gzan mchu zlum thams cad dang*// khrung khrung tshe ring ljongs kyi bya// ngang ngur pad+mo rdzing gi rgyan// bzhad dang chu skyar la sogs pa// 'dam gzan mchu leb thams cad de// srid pa'i bya rigs ma lus pa// yon bdag glud du 'bul gyis bzhes// ri dwags rgyal po gdong lnga pa// dmar ser ral pas brjid pa la// lus grim rkang pa brgyad pa'i shugs// ri dwags srog gi gshed gyur dang*// stag bu 'dzum drug 'khyil ba'i blon// dpa' bo gzig chen thig le can// ce spyang dur khrod pho nya dang*// khyi nag dug gi mche ba can// dom bu lus nag snying dkar dang*// dred mo mi gzan la sogs pa// gcan gzan gtum dgu'i rigs kun dang*// glang chen thal kar mche ba drug

/bzhin mdzes e n+ya ya dang ni// kriṣ+ṇā sa ra sna dgo gnyan// blo ldan ri bong gla ba rkyang*// ri dwags rigs su rngod rnams dang*// g.yag rgod ngar ba'i kha rlangs can// 'bri mo ngur ba'i skad can dang*// g.yang lug 'bal sgra 'byin pa dang*// rtsa ra ri dbrag myul ba dang*/ mdzo glang rwa brdar sa slog dang*// ma he rmig pa sar rdeb mkhan// cang shes rta dang dre'u dang*// bong bu la sogs rmig chags te// yon bdag nor dang mthun pa'i phyugs// chu srin nya mid chen po dang*// ma hā gser gyi ru sbal dang*// nya chen yor mo la sogs pa'i// chur gnas srog chags thams cad dang*// gdug pa'i dug sbrul sgram chen sogs// khung du 'dzul ba thams cad dang*// khyad par sa gsum gzhon nu'i sde// dpa' zhing rtul phod yan lag can// na chung yid srub rtse dga'i shing*// ji ltar yid kyis sprul la sogs// srog chags thams cad glud du 'bul// lha dbang rnams dang mi dbang dang*// klu dbang rnams kyi gtsug rgyan nas// man shel bar gyi rin chen dang*// shing tog sman dang bza' bca' dang*// btung dang 'bru sna dar zab sogs// dkor cha kun kyang 'bul lags so//

phyugs dang 'bangs kyi glud do// gnyis pa mdos la rdzongs bstabs pa la/ chos nyid kyi rdzongs/ mdos kyi rdzongs// dregs par rdzong ba gsum/ dang po ni/ hūm̐ thog mtha' bar med ka dag dbyings// srid dang zhi bar ma chad pa// khregs gcod ye shes skye ba'i khungs// kun khyab chos kyi sku chen po// nam mkha' lta bur go 'byed pas// lhun gyis grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin// thod brgal nyams kyis gzigs mo'i gnas/ longs spyod rdzogs pa chen po'i sku// cir yang snang ba sprul pa'i sku// chos dang chos nyid kun zad pa// sku gsum ye shes rnam pa lngar// thag chod thig le'i klong mdos 'bul// 'khor gsum mi dmigs 'di kho na// rdzogs pa chen po'i mdos lags so// mdos rdzongs/ la rdzas/ klung rdzas/ lho zog byang zog mdos kyi rdzongs chang bu ting lo sogs te/ hūm̐ don dam de bzhin nyid kyi gdangs// rkyen gyi ngo na cir snang yang*// dri med me long byad lta bu// brtags na kun rdzob snang ba 'jig /de phyir ma brtags nyams dga' ba'i// sgyu 'phrul chen po'i longs spyod ni// nam mkha'i mdzod rdzas ngo ma rnams// de ring mdos kyi rdzongs su 'debs// 'di la chad pa ci yang med// gang bzhed mdos la 'byung ba'i phyir// 'di las phun tshogs gar yang med// de phyir kun bzang mchod pa'i sbrin// sri zhu mgon po lan chags dang*// snying rje'i mgron kun tshim nus pas// 'di ni bsam 'phel nor bu lags// mi zad gter gyi bum pa'ang ste// rin chen 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho dang*// dgos 'dod stsol ba'i dpag bsam shing*// de phyir 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams// tshang mar bdag gis 'bul lags so// mdos dregs pa la rdzongs bstabs la// sger mdos 'dir gtong*/ hūm̐ srid pa gsum gyi dbang po che// ma hā kā la lcam dral tshogs// zhing skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bgegs chen drag po mthu rtsal can/

sde brgyad mgon po thams cad dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba chen po'i tshogs// lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*// gshin rje pho mo srin po dang*// nyi zla gza' skar me lha dang*// dri za drang srong rlung lha dang*// yi dwags sha za brjed byed dang*// smyo byed grul bum srul po dang*// nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci// lha min mi min 'byung po dang*// rgyal po btsan dang bdud dang dmu// sa bdag gnyan dang klu bsen dang*// yul lha yul bdag ma sangs sman// 'go dang bsten dang chags pa dang*// bse rags yul 'dre 'phung sri dang*// dur sri gshin 'dre gshin log dang*// srid pa'i lha 'dre ma lus pa// sde ris 'khor bcas thams cad la// mthun pa'i rdzas dang bzhed pa'i dkor// ji ltar 'dod pa sbyar zhing bshams// bsngos shing phul bas thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid gsum tshim gyur cig /kyai ma mthong ma thos ma shes dang*// ma sleb mi gda' dbang chung bas// skal ba ma thob thams cad pa// skyems dang brngon gyis tshim gyur cig /de ltar thams cad mchod pa'i mthus// bar du gcod pa kun zhi nas// bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang*// rnam thos bu bzhin nor ldan la// nyi zla mnyam pa'i tshe thob shog /gzhan yang yul khams bde ba dang*// lo legs skya rgyal rgyal po rnams// chos bzhin rgyal srid skyong gyur pas// thub bstan rtag tu rgyas gyur cig/ gsum pa mdos gzhug zor gyis bcad pa la/ glud skor/ mdos lam/ drag por zor du bya ba'i tshul lo// dang po chad rdo bskul btang*/ kyai da ni glud skor g.yas su bskor// glud chen g.yas su bskor tsa na// snang srid lha 'dre g.yas su 'khor// bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// dgyes pa'i mdangs dang bcas te 'khor// skyes pa pho yi skyeg zlog cig /glud chen g.yon du bskor tsa na// ma yams nag mo g.yon du 'khor// bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// dgyes pa'i mdangs dang bcas te 'khor// za ma mo yi skyeg zlog cig

/glud skor gcig dang gnyis dang gsum// zhag skor zla skor lo skor glud// nad dang gdon gyi zhen pa chung*// glud dang 'grogs te lam la song*// gnyis pa/ mdos lam/ dregs pa'i lam/ dgra la lam bstan pa ste/ kyai mdos dang glud kyi lam bstan no// ri gsum rtse dang lung gsum mdo// rgya gram lam dang 'bab chu'i gzhung*// nyi zla'i grib so mdos kyi lam// 'dre lnga bdud gcod mdos kyi phyogs// lam der zhugs la phyogs der song*// dregs pa'i lam bstan pa/ kyai da gshegs phar la sha ra ra// da bzhud gzhan du si li li// bshul lam nam mkha'i mthongs su ltos// dgu tshigs lha dbang lam la song*// bshul lam rgya mtsho'i dbyings su ltos// klu rgyal 'bum sde lam la song*// bshul lam ri bdun rtse la song*// gnod sbyin drag po'i lam la song*// bshul lam gang nas byon der song*// rten dang pho brang dag tu gshegs// dgra la lam bstan pa/ hūm̐ thugs kyi sprul pa bdud 'dul chen po ni// dur khrod chen po'i gnas nas mtho ris gshegs// lha dmag dkar po kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad// lha min dpung tshogs g.yul du brlag par byas// de nas byang chub snying po'i shing drung du// bdud dpung bye ba dung phyur thams cad bcom// mu stegs nag po'i phyogs kun cham la phab// sngon gyi dgra 'dul de bzhin dgra bo 'di// tshar gcod las la dpal mgon 'khor bcas spyon// ma hā kā la'i tshogs kyis drag shul mdzod// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i nad rims thams cad thong*// lha srin sde brgyad 'jig rten skyong ba'i dpung*// gnam sa khong la bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs// drag po zor du bya ba/ hūm̐ yon bdag byol kha dgra la bh+yo// rgyu sbyor bdud kha bgegs la bh+yo// dal kha rims kha dgra la sgyur// mdos yas drag po'i zor du sgyur// gnod byed dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod// ngar glud rgyan gyi rdzas rnams kyang*// zhub can khrom tshogs dpung gi zor// mda' khra 'phen byed mda' yi zor// 'phang khra gdug pa rtsang gi zor// pho gdong mo gdong thod pa'i zor// shing bam mdung rtse dbal gyi zor// yungs kar khro chung thun gyi zor// mtshe mo 'bigs byed mtshon gyi zor// bal tshon sna lnga byad kyi zor// bya spu ltas ngan than gyi zor// zor kha dgra dang bgegs la bh+yo// longs skyod dkor rdzas spyan gzigs kyang*// 'joms byed gdug pa'i zor du sgyur// mkha' la 'phyo ba'i 'dab chags kyang*// mkha' lding mchu sder can gyi zor// nags la rgyu ba'i gcan gzan yang*// za byed mche ba can gyi zor// ri la gnas pa'i ri dwags kyang*// ltas ngan gnod pa can gyi zor// dud 'gro phyugs kyi rigs rnams kyang*// tshul dang mi mthun ltas ngan zor// longs spyod rin chen rnam lnga yang*// lcags zangs rdo thun char gyi zor// mdzes pa'i dar tshon sna lnga yang*// 'du ba rnam lnga nad kyi zor// bkra shis shug ti de dag kyang*// mi sdug mgo 'thoms byur gyi zor// gtsang lug lpags pa dkar nag kyang*// g.yang gzhi dul nag g.yab mo'i zor// tshon 'byed btsag rams ri mo yang*// khra bo gcan gzan gzugs kyi zor// yas gzhi kham sa rgyan glud 'di// 'bru khung zur gsum kong bu'i zor// 'bru sna rin chen sna bdun yang*// drag po rdzas dug thun gyi zor// chang phud rngon cha gser skyems kyang*// myos byed rba klong khrag gi zor// bshos bu zhal zas sna tshogs kyang*// lus sems rlag byed dbal gyi zor// dam rdzas sha khrag sna tshogs kyang*// mtshon 'khrugs tsha ba nad kyi zor// de ltar drag po'i mdos zor 'di/

steng gi phyogs su 'phangs pa yis// lha chen rnams kyi dregs pa zlog /shar gyi phyogs su 'phangs pa yis// brgya byin dri za'i g.yeng ba zlog /shar lho mtshams su 'phangs pa yis// me lha drang srong dmod pa zlog /lho yi phyogs su 'phangs pa yis// yi dwags gshin rje'i 'ching byed zlog /lho nub 'tshams su 'phangs pa yis// bden bral srin po za kha zlog /nub kyi phyogs su 'phangs pa yis// gdug pa klu yi dug chen zlog /nub byang mtshams su 'phangs pa yis// rlung lha nyi 'byed bskrad pa zlog /byang gi phyogs su 'phangs pa yis// gnod sbyin gsod gcod gnod pa zlog /byang shar mtshams su 'phangs pa yis// log 'dren bgegs kyi bar gcod zlog /'og gi phyogs su 'phangs pa yis// sa bdag gnyan gyi byad kha zlog /drag po'i byol zor 'di 'phangs pas// lha srin sde brgyad ma lus pa'i// gdug rtsub gnod cing 'tshe ba zlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa yi// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad yams zlog /rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa dang*// phas kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa zlog /ban bon sngags pa nag po'i mthu// thams cad byad ma rang la zlog /sdang ba'i dgra la zor kha ya// gnod pa'i bgegs la zor kha ya// de nas mnan pa dang sreg pa gtor chen gyi dus bzhin no// zhes dpal mgon po'i mdos chog rdo rje 'dzin pa mthu chen dpa' bo'am chos kyi mgon pos ring mo zhig nas rtsom par bskul ba bzhin pad+ma dkar pos srid pa pho byol la sogs pa slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i legs par bshad par kun dang mthun par sbyar ba/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i rkyen chen por gyur cig shu bha mastu sarba dza gtām// na mo rat+na trayā ya/ oṃ edharmā hetupra bha wā he tun+teṣān+tathāgatoh+yawadat/ teṣāñtsa yonirodha.ewaṃwādīmahāshra maṇa ya swā hā/ maṅga laṃ/// /
